title: Feds ransack Chuck Clark's place

tellings.quote: his place was was ransacked by the by the feds

plain: In the 1990s, federal agents ransacked the home of a man named Chuck Clark in Rachel, Nevada, the tiny town near the secret Area 51 air base. The documentary filmmaker James Fox tells this, naming the journalist George Knapp and Clark himself as his sources. It is told as a sign that the government was pressing people who watched the area.
